name: Commnet Internet Services
summary: Sydney south (Taren Point) dialup ISP (unlimited plans); ISP homepage in Wayback only 2001-02, defunct by mid-2000s.

events.details: Listed in the Cynosure ISP directory (2001); earliest own-domain Wayback capture Dec 2001.
ISP homepage present in Wayback only 2001-02; no captures 2003-2013, then a minimal placeholder page 2014-2019 (not an active ISP). Exact closure unclear; retail ISP presence gone by mid-2000s.
